newsitem.title: SWEDEN: FORECAST - Swedish PPI seen rising 0.2 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Swedish PPI seen rising 0.2 pct in Feb.

text.p: Sweden's Producer Price Index (PPI) is expected to show a month-on-month rise of 0.2 percent in February and a year-on-year fall of 1.9 percent, a Reuters survey of 13 analysts showed on Friday.
In January the PPI rose 0.3 percent from December and 2.2 percent from 12 months ago.
Statistics Sweden will release the PPI for February at 0900 GMT on March 26.
Forecasts for February producer prices ranged between a fall of 0.1 percent and a rise of 0.6 percent from January and a fall of between 2.3 and 1.4 percent from a year ago.
The PPI was unchanged in February 1996, giving an annualised rise of 1.1 percent.

Analysts interviewed for the poll were from Chase, Consensus, Den Danske Bank, Hagstromer & Qviberg, Handelsbanken, HSBC Midland, JP Morgan, Nomura, Nordbanken, PaineWebber, Salomon, S-E-Banken, and UBS.
